title: GOOLOO GT4000 4000A Jump Starter US$73.88 (~A$105.71), GP4000 Pro 4000A US$52.35 (~A$$74.90) AU Stock Del @ GOOLOO AliExpress
body:
Deal: GOOLOO GT4000 4000A Jump Starter US$73.88 (~A$105.71), GP4000 Pro 4000A US$52.35 (~A$$74.90) AU Stock Del @ GOOLOO AliExpress

[kulprit] Thanks Clear for the deal,
I still get so confused on Ali sometimes. Going back through previous Gooloo A3 deals, there are two possible links to the item that have different prices.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/961653 - Currently $65.58US, and shows as sold by GOOLOO global warehouse at top right
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/959876 - $45.46 with no seller on the main page, but when added to cart also shows as GOOLOO global warehouse.
This just one of the fun part of Aliexpress?
[Clear] They are special discount links. When the seller doesn't show up top you'll see this at the bottom:
Explanation of the Supplier
Important Notes
This special page helps aggregate consumer reviews and sales volume of similar items offered by multiple overseas merchants for your easy reference.
Information of the Seller
The seller of this item is GOOLOO Global Warehouse Store
[kulprit] Awesome, thanks Clear. So the $41.46 after the code it almost the best prices its been.
Realise the listed ones here are better as jump packs, but the air compressor seems like too good a feature to miss out on. Appreciate you last time finding another brand model as well.
[jimojr] I tried using another account to buy a second one, but it says, "This item can't be delivered to your address," and only gives me the "Find Similar" option.
[Clear] What state? I'll feed it back to AliExpress to have sorted.
[jimojr] VIC. I had no issues buying the first one. Since the code could only be used once, I tried buying a second one with another account that I hadn't used for over a year, but that's when I got the "This item can't be delivered to your address" message.
Even when I tried using my friend's home address, I got the same message.
[djrossco] I get ‘ this item can’t be delivered to your address’ when I try to order
[slipperypete] so I get
For security reasons your request can't currently be processed when i try to put in code?
anyone get the same?
[Clear] There's alternative codes. Sometimes you can try typing the code instead of copy paste
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/969555
[bashar20] I recall these used to be cheaper back on the day? Or where they lower capacity for smaller cars?
[Clear] Back in the day they were 1200A and 2000A jump starters for this price. When 4000A first turned up Gooloo were selling them for $170+ on sale.
